summary.text: Elias Coop-Gonzalez is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 67, listed with Randolph County. His legislative page lists committee assignments on Education, Higher Education and Public Education.

paragraphs.text: Coop-Gonzalez's page gives his birth date as May 2, 2002, and lists his occupation as college student and his religion as Christian.
